abstract: Gemcitabine (GEM) resistance poses a significant challenge to the survival of patients with pancreatic cancer. A key mechanism underlying this resistance is the aberrant activation of the pentose phosphate pathway (PPP), which leads to increased levels of deoxycytidine triphosphate (dCTP) and competitively inhibits the incorporation of gemcitabine into DNA. However, the upstream regulator of PPP hyperactivation in GEM-resistant pancreatic cancer remains unclear. Here, we reported that SP1-CD44 signaling modulated gemcitabine sensitivity and PPP-associated metabolic parameters in pancreatic cancer. Mechanistically, knockdown of SP1 reduced G6PDH activity and decreased the levels of NADPH and G6P, whereas overexpression of CD44 resulted in the opposite effects. Functionally, inhibition of this axis increased the sensitivity of pancreatic cancer cells to GEM. Given its therapeutic potential, we sought to identify candidate SP1-targeting compounds with the potential to enhance gemcitabine sensitivity. A small-scale screen of known SP1 inhibitors revealed mithramycin A (MIT) to be effective, but its significant toxicity is well documented. To identify safer alternatives, we screened anti‑pancreatic cancer natural products in the natural product library of our laboratory, guided by computer-aided drug discovery. Molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulations suggested that arenobufagin (ABA) and bufalin (BA) may bind to SP1. In summary, our findings support a role for the SP1-CD44 axis in gemcitabine resistance and suggest that enhanced PPP-associated metabolic activity may contribute to this phenotype. Furthermore, we identified ABA and BA as candidate compounds that increase gemcitabine-associated apoptosis in pancreatic cancer cells, warranting further investigation of their potential as SP1-targeting agents.
key_points_ko: SP1-CD44 신호전달축 억제는 췌장암 세포의 gemcitabine(젬시타빈) 민감도를 향상시킵니다.
SP1 노크다운은 G6PDH 활성과 NADPH 및 G6P 수준을 감소시켜 펜토스 인산 경로 대사를 억제했습니다.
천연물 화합물인 arenobufagin(ABA)과 bufalin(BA)이 SP1에 결합하여 gemcitabine 유도 세포사멸을 증가시키는 후보 물질로 확인되었습니다.
summary_ko: 본 연구는 췌장암 세포에서 SP1-CD44 신호전달축이 펜토스 인산 경로(PPP) 대사를 조절하여 gemcitabine(젬시타빈) 내성에 관여함을 밝혔습니다. 연구진은 SP1 유전자 발현 억제가 G6PDH 활성과 NADPH, G6P 수준을 낮춰 gemcitabine 민감도를 높임을 확인했습니다. 또한 컴퓨터 스크리닝을 통해 천연 화합물인 arenobufagin(아레노부파진)과 bufalin(부파린)을 SP1 표적 기반 gemcitabine 감수성 증대 후보 물질로 발굴했습니다.
title: SP1-CD44 signaling modulates PPP-associated metabolism and gemcitabine sensitivity in pancreatic cancer cells
title_ko: 췌장암 세포에서 펜토스 인산 경로 관련 대사 및 젬시타빈 민감도를 조절하는 SP1-CD44 신호전달
